item.tib: gsang sngags khro bo rol pa'i lag len reg zeg nyung bsdus
item.coloph: ces gsang sngags khro bo rol pa'i lag len reg zeg nyung bsdus 'di bzod dka' zhes bya/ me pho khyi yi lo nag pa zla ba'i 'phel phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes mig dmar dbyug gu'i 'grub sbyor bzang po nyin/ sprul ming tshul khrims dbang grags kyis g.yung drung bstan rgyas gling du thun mtshams su bris pa dge legs 'phel/ tha tshan mu tsug smar ro//
